Pulse for 13 October 2026

The stories from 13 October 2026 in the Pulse of the Sapaude app, in our own words. Terms you don’t know are explained in the glossary. Glossary

Everyday tool

Shop through any AI agent

MCP is a standard plug that lets an AI agent use outside tools, and Shopify's new Shop MCP lets any compatible agent search products, fill a cart, and check out with Shop Pay once you approve.

Everyday tool

Steer your Facebook feed

A recommendation algorithm is the system that picks which posts you see, and Facebook now lets you tell it in plain words what you want more or less of in Feed and Reels.

New model

Run AI agents offline

An AI agent is an assistant that completes tasks in several steps; Liquid AI's new open model is built to run such agents fast and privately on your own laptop instead of in the cloud.

Everyday tool

Build your own app, no code

Google AI Studio is a free browser tool where you describe an app in plain words and AI builds it; since October 13, Google lets you run that app on your own Android phone through Google Play without a developer account.

New model

Gemini's top model is live

A frontier model is a top-tier AI system meant for hard, multi-step work, and Google says Gemini 4 Argon is now open to paying developers and Pro and Ultra subscribers after weeks of limited testing.

Everyday tool

Claude animates explainers

An animated explainer is a short moving graphic that teaches an idea, and Anthropic says Claude can now build those as editable code, plus live dashboards from your company data.

Everyday tool

Direct AI voices yourself

Text-to-speech is software that turns written words into spoken audio, and Fish Audio's new Drama 3 model lets you direct that speech in plain language the way you would brief an actor.

In the background

Small AI cuts agent costs

An AI agent is an assistant that works through a task in many steps; ScaleDown's new small models take over the routine sorting and summarizing inside those steps, so the big model doesn't have to.
